about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It was introduced with the 2019 facelift of the L550 generation and remains in production today. The AJ200P is the mid-output version of the Ingenium petrol family, sitting between the P200 and the discontinued P290 in the Discovery Sport range.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200P engines for every Discovery Sport P250 on the road.
